metadata.title: Omnichannel Commerce ERP Residuality Stress Test
metadata.description: How Logic4's all-in-one platform must change when group consolidation, e-invoicing rules, marketplace growth, warehouse scale or AI buying shift its context.
metadata.naiveArchitecture: One monolithic ERP and webshop per tenant with modules sharing tables, point-to-point integrations built per customer, carrier and payment plugins hard-wired into order code, and accounting exports by file.
metadata.residualArchitecture: One shared commerce core (items, prices, orders, stock, ledger) emitting events; a public API and integration hub with standard sibling bridges; channel, EDI, carrier and returns connectors behind stable contracts; tenant hierarchy of administrations and branches; e-invoicing as a connector to the ledger; built-in WMS with a clean hand-off to Picqer.

stressors.name: Group siblings overlap with Logic4 modules
stressors.detection: Katapull adds Picqer (WMS) in October 2026 next to Vendit (POS) and Highbiza (B2B webshops); customers ask which product to use.
stressors.attractor: Customers expect one integrated experience across sibling brands and no forced migrations.
stressors.businessReaction: Position built-in modules as the default and siblings as step-ups; build standard bridges via the integration hub instead of duplicating features.
stressors.residue: Integration hub with standard sibling connectors and shared identifiers.

impacts.effect: Hands off to Picqer for complex warehouses.
JTL already offers an integrated hub of modules.

stressors.name: Structured B2B e-invoicing becomes mandatory
stressors.detection: Belgium mandates structured B2B e-invoicing from 2026; EU ViDA and Dutch plans follow.
stressors.attractor: Invoices must be sent and received as structured data over Peppol.
stressors.businessReaction: Add an e-invoice connector to the ledger and invoice run; receive purchase invoices as data.
stressors.residue: E-invoicing as a connector of the accounting brick, not a separate export.

stressors.name: Marketplaces take a growing share of online sales
stressors.detection: Customers report more revenue on bol and Amazon than on their own shop.
stressors.attractor: Stock and order sync with marketplaces becomes as critical as the own webshop.
stressors.businessReaction: Real-time stock events and robust order import with payment and VAT mapping.
stressors.residue: Event-driven stock publication shared by webshop, POS and channels.

stressors.name: Buyers order through AI agents and conversational interfaces
stressors.detection: Search traffic shifts to AI assistants; B2B buyers ask for API ordering.
stressors.attractor: Product data and ordering must be machine-readable and transactable outside the storefront.
stressors.businessReaction: Expose structured product feeds and ordering APIs with customer-specific prices.
stressors.residue: Public API and structured catalog as first-class channels.

stressors.name: Fast-growing customers outgrow the all-in-one package
stressors.detection: Customers with high order volumes or many warehouses evaluate Business Central or dedicated WMS.
stressors.attractor: Logic4 loses its most valuable customers unless it can scale specific modules.
stressors.businessReaction: Offer Picqer and DeliveryMatch as plug-in step-ups and keep the core as system of record.
stressors.residue: Composable edges: modules replaceable by siblings while the core keeps orders and ledger.

impacts.effect: Retention via Picqer step-up for shipping volume.
